ROOT.triggerdef:
create trigger cdn.KnAFlagaDomyslny_Trg on cdn.KntAdresy for insert, update as begin if not update(KnA_Domyslny) return; set nocount on
declare @tempKnAGT smallint declare @tempKnAGN int declare @tempKnAGF int declare @tempKnADomyslny smallint declare @tempKnKGT smallint declare @tempKnKGN int declare @tempKnKGF int
declare trg_cur cursor local for select KnA_GIDTyp,KnA_GIDNumer,KnA_GIDFirma,KnA_Domyslny,KnA_KntTyp,KnA_KntFirma,KnA_KntNumer from inserted open trg_cur if @@error = 0 begin while 1=1 begin fetch next from trg_cur into @tempKnAGT,@tempKnAGN,@tempKnAGF,@tempKnADomyslny,@tempKnKGT,@tempKnKGF,@tempKnKGN if @@fetch_status <> 0 break
if @tempKnADomyslny is not null if @tempKnADomyslny <> 0 begin update cdn.kntAdresy set KnA_Domyslny=0 where knA_KntTyp=@tempKnKGT and knA_KntFirma=@tempKnKGF and knA_KntNumer=@tempKnKGN and (knA_GIDTyp = 864 or knA_GIDTyp = 896) and KnA_GIDFirma = @tempKnAGF and KnA_GIDNumer <> @tempKnAGN end end close trg_cur end deallocate trg_cur
set nocount on end
